meta.name: article-writing
meta.description: Write articles, guides, blog posts, tutorials, newsletter issues, and other long-form content in a distinctive voice derived from supplied examples or brand guidance. Use when the user wants polished written content longer than a paragraph, especially when voice consistency, structure, and credibility matter.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出风格统一的长篇内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要持续产出有个人风格的长文内容
copy.tagline_en: Write long-form content with consistent voice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce polished long-form content with a distinctive voice

howto.what: Claude 会帮你写文章、博客、教程、新闻稿等长内容，模仿你提供的风格或品牌语气，避免空洞套话，用具体例子和证据支撑观点。
howto.when: 当你需要写超过一段的正式内容，比如博客、教程、新闻稿，或者想把笔记、录音整理成文章时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于Python入门的博客，语气像技术博主。
把这段会议录音整理成一篇新闻稿，语气正式。
say.note: Claude会提取要点，按新闻稿格式输出。

howto.what_en: Claude writes articles, blogs, tutorials, newsletters, and other long-form content in a distinctive voice from your examples or brand guidance, avoiding clichés and using concrete evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need polished long-form content like blog posts, tutorials, or newsletters, or when turning notes or transcripts into articles.

say_en.text: Write a blog post about Python for beginners in a tech blogger voice.
say_en.note: Claude follows technical guide structure with code examples.

say_en.text: Turn this meeting transcript into a newsletter issue in a formal tone.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key points and formats as newsletter.
